test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution: The incorrectly spelt word is: **Pattron** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The incorrect spelling "**pattron**" includes an extra "**t**," and the correct spelling is "**patron**." • The word "**patron**" refers to a person who supports, sponsors, or is a regular customer of a business, organization, or individual. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी व्यवसाय, संगठन या व्यक्ति का समर्थन करता है, प्रायोजित करता है या उसका नियमित ग्राहक है) • They often provide financial assistance, encouragement, or advocacy. • **For example-** *A patron of the arts might financially support an art gallery, or a patron of a restaurant is a loyal customer who frequently dines there.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • The rest of the words are correctly spelt, now look at the meaning of these words. • **Connotation**: An idea expressed by a word in addition to its main meaning. (शब्‍द के मुख्‍य अर्थ के अलावा अन्‍य आशय; संकेतार्थ) • **Dearth**: A lack of something; not enough of something. (किसी वस्‍तु की कमी; अपर्याप्त) • **Quarry**: A place where sand, stone, etc. is dug out of the ground. (बालू, पत्‍थर आदि की खदान या खान) 1cd:Ta24, The correct answer is: **Gathered**
